description:
Maui Mask is a single-ingredient Hawaiian volcanic clay face mask hand-harvested from our family farm in Haiku, Maui. Our clay forms over thousands of years on the slopes of Haleakalā and contains a rare mineral matrix — halloysite, allophane, imogolite, kaolinite, and bentonite — found almost nowhere else on earth. Naturally pH 5.5, never touches plastic, sun-dried, and free of additives of any kind. Every jar funds active land restoration on our farm — removing invasive species and replanting native koa, taro, and food forests. One ingredient. One mission. Made in Hawaii.

Most clay masks are single-mineral commodity powders mined in bulk from alkaline dry lake beds at pH 9-10. Maui Mask is a rare multi-mineral volcanic clay harvested by hand in small batches on a family farm in Maui. Naturally pH 5.5 — perfectly matched to human skin — no vinegar needed, no harsh alkaline burn, no disruption to your skin's natural barrier. The result that overwhelmingly surprises first-time users is how impossibly smooth their skin feels afterward. There is nothing else like it in commercial skincare.

We offer one of the most generous commission structures in natural skincare — starting at 20% and advancing automatically through five tiers up to 40% at our Koa tier. Customers who shop through your affiliate link receive free shipping automatically applied at checkout. Our 60-day cookie window means you receive credit even if someone takes weeks to decide. Commissions are tracked in real time through your affiliate dashboard and tiers advance automatically with no manual requests needed.

Maui Mask sells best through honest personal content. Show the ritual — mixing the clay with water, honey, or yogurt, applying it, and the glowing result. Talk about what makes it different — the pH, the rare minerals, the Hawaiian origin, the plastic-free process. Content that performs well includes skincare routines, ingredient deep-dives, skin texture comparisons, and anything that connects the product to its Hawaiian volcanic origin and land restoration mission.

We are a small family operation based in Haiku, Maui, Hawaii. Every jar ships via USPS Priority Mail from Maui. Free shipping on all US orders over $60. Currently shipping within the United States only. We personally review and approve all affiliate applications. If you would like a complimentary jar after approval, reach out at aloha@mauimask.com and we will take care of you. We are building something real and we want partners who believe in it.
